title: HELIOS — Mission Intelligence
persona: HELIOS mission-intelligence, flight operations for the crewed vessel Aurelian (fictional deep-space program)
tagline: Every mission decision, grounded in the ship's own documentation — because 80 million km from Earth, a hallucinated answer is fatal.
elevatorPitch: This is the highest-stakes knowledge work there is: a Mars-transit flight team resolving a live anomaly, where every answer is cited to a procedure, a flight rule, or a past anomaly — never invented. If grounded AI can be trusted here, it can run your enterprise's knowledge without hallucinating.

surfaces.label: Ask
surfaces.tagline: Streamed answers that always show their sources.
surfaces.sells: Grounded answers with citations — the antidote to hallucination, the single most important thing an exec needs to believe.

surfaces.label: Voice
surfaces.tagline: Speak to the assistant and hear grounded, cited answers back.
surfaces.sells: Real-time spoken Q&A that stays grounded and cited — the same governance as text, hands-free. The demo that makes a room lean in.

surfaces.label: Search
surfaces.tagline: Meaning-based retrieval that beats keyword search on the same corpus.
surfaces.sells: Type a concept, not a keyword, and the right document surfaces — the 'aha' every buyer feels instantly.

surfaces.label: Assets
surfaces.tagline: A governed asset library with semantic discovery and Ask-the-Archive.
surfaces.sells: Find the right asset by meaning, not filename; ask the archive a question and get a cited answer over images, video and documents — DAM that understands its own library.

surfaces.label: Graph
surfaces.tagline: Entities and relationships ARAG extracts during processing.
surfaces.sells: The graph surfaces connections no keyword search would — related matters, people, assets — the 'we didn't know we knew that' moment.

surfaces.label: Doc Studio
surfaces.tagline: Drop a document, watch classify → extract → validate → standardise.
surfaces.sells: An invoice, contract or claim becomes structured JSON in eight visible steps — the automation ROI story on a plate.

surfaces.label: Calls
surfaces.tagline: Analytics over transcribed calls: resolution, compliance, CSAT.
surfaces.sells: Every call auto-scored for compliance, first-call resolution and cross-sell — QA that used to sample 2% now covers 100%.

surfaces.label: Workflows
surfaces.tagline: Multi-step retrieval agents that reason over the KB.
surfaces.sells: Not one answer — a chain of grounded steps (retrieve, reason, compose) that mirrors how an analyst actually works.

surfaces.label: For You
surfaces.sells: One ARAG plugin replaces five point tools for search, recs, chat and SEO — all grounded in the catalogue.

surfaces.label: Related
surfaces.tagline: "More like this" that understands content — semantic similarity plus shared-entity graph traversal.
surfaces.sells: Recommendations that go beyond tags: find titles that are close in meaning AND connected through the knowledge graph's shared entities — the YouTube-style 'related titles' that actually knows the content.

surfaces.label: Visibility
surfaces.tagline: How your brand appears across AI models, and how to fix it.
surfaces.sells: Measure brand appearance across the model catalogue and make content retrievable via MCP — the AEO/AI-visibility narrative.

surfaces.label: Quality
surfaces.tagline: REMi scores every answer for groundedness and relevance.
surfaces.sells: A live groundedness score turns 'trust me' into a number an exec can govern against.

surfaces.label: MCP
surfaces.tagline: The KB as an MCP server other agents can call.
surfaces.sells: Your content becomes a tool any AI agent can call — the Agent-Experience story that lands with technical buyers.

safety.disclaimer: Demonstration data — HELIOS and the vessel Aurelian are fictional; a synthetic deep-space program built to showcase grounded, cited AI. Not a real mission, spacecraft, or agency.

demoScript.say: T+248 days. A pressure drop on ECLSS coolant loop B. The flight director asks HELIOS out loud — and hears a grounded answer back, cited to the exact malfunction procedure.
demoScript.show: Voice: 'malfunction procedure for coolant loop B pressure drop' → spoken cited answer

demoScript.say: Every answer carries a groundedness score. Here, that number is the difference between a crew that lives and one that doesn't — so we govern against it.
demoScript.show: Quality: groundedness near 100%, refusal probes decline

demoScript.say: Has this happened before? HELIOS recalls similar past-mission anomalies by meaning and by the subsystems they share — not by tags.
demoScript.show: Related: past coolant anomalies via semantic + graph

demoScript.say: The graph traces the cascade — which components, procedures and subsystems are connected to a cabin thermal rise.
demoScript.show: Graph around the ECLSS coolant loop entity

demoScript.say: And it declines when it must. Ask it something the mission record can't support, and it refuses — out loud — instead of inventing.
demoScript.show: A refusal probe → explicit ungrounded decline
